---
{
    "name": "urbo devcontainer",
	"dockerComposeFile": [
        "frontend.yaml"
    ],
	"service": "frontend",
	"workspaceFolder": "/workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}",
    "features": {
        "ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node:1": {
            "version": "20.19.0",
            "pnpmVersion": "10.6.3"
        },
        "ghcr.io/devcontainers-extra/features/gradle-sdkman:2": {
            "jdkVersion" : "21",
            "jdkDistro" : "oracle"
        }
	},
    "postCreateCommand": "bash -i -c 'cd app && pnpm i'", 
    "postAttachCommand": "bash -i -c 'cd app && pnpm run build:all && pnpm run start:api-prod-proxy:external'",
    "waitFor" : "postCreateCommand",
    "forwardPorts": [4200]
}services:
    frontend:
      container_name: urbo-frontend
      image: debian:stable
      command: sleep infinity
      ports:
        - "4200:4200"
      restart: unless-stopped

devcontainer.json
frontend.yaml

observation.command: cd /workspace; env | grep -iE 'github|token|proxy' ; echo "---"; cat .devcontainer/* 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls .devcontainer
